narrative:
Ross County has 45,155 registered voters, with 15.3% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 24.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 53.3%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 28.7 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.6% of registrants.
